
body:
```suggestion
				Starts draw call pre-sorting or changes the pre-sorting level. All subsequent draw calls until [method canvas_item_flush_presort] is called are sorted according to the [param order] and texture usage, to ensure draw call batching. The original call order is not preserved. If [method canvas_item_flush_presort] is never called, this method has no effect. Draw calls made before the first [method canvas_item_set_presort_level] call or after [method canvas_item_flush_presort] is called are also not affected.
```

Also:
- Should mention `order >= 0` requirement.
- Could be clarified that smaller `order` means drawn first/behind, but it's probably fine as is / it's intuitive enough. E.g. `canvas_item_set_draw_index` docs also don't explain it.
_"the rest of this method"_ is a little misleading, there's more after the `canvas_item_flush_presort` call (draw carets and so on).
